title: # VPS: reads run free, destructive stays on veto (Brett, Nov 7) Brett is drowning in 90 s veto hold…
asked: # VPS: reads run free, destructive stays on veto (Brett, Nov 7) Brett is drowning in 90 s veto holds for read-only vps.run commands. Rule: anything read-only runs at once (no hold); anything that changes state keeps the veto countdown. 1. Add to the vps service's `check` (fixed, read-only, no approval) the reads sessions keep needing via vps.run: `grep` (pattern + path under /opt/axf or /root/axf-builds, read-only, capped output), `file` (cat/head a file under those roots, capped, secrets hidden), `ls` (dir listing), `claude_accounts` (deploy/claude-workers.mjs status + claude-login.mjs accounts), `queue` (headless launch queue entries), `git_status` (one build folder), `config` (a plugin's plugin.json/settings). Strict path allowlist; no shell metacharacters; no writes. 2. Add `build_queue_remove` (remove a not-yet-started entry from the headless launch queue by build name/queue id) as an allow tool like build_stop. 3. Add `build_clean` (discard uncommitted _claude/builds/** sync files in a build folder) and make `build_land` do it by itself before landing, so finished builds never block on sync noise. 4. Keep `run` and `logs` on veto. Update tool descriptions so sessions prefer `check` for reads. 5. Tests for every new check (path escape, metacharacters, caps, secret masking). Docs + decision entry. Progress: append `<time> START|DONE <step>` to PROGRESS.md here at each step; don't stop between steps. Commit, don't push. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once. Model switches: a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. Fable upgrades need no approval right now (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable"): a step that needs Fable (schemas, asset types, contracts, engines/kernel, cross-app protocols) is set to Fable and runs on Fable; the switch is recorded on the build. Never launch a step on a higher model than it is pinned to: raise the step first.

result.summary: vps.check: grep/file/ls/config/queue/claude_accounts/git_status; build_clean + build_queue_remove; build_land auto-cleans _claude/builds; decision #117; 582 tests
